_notes: The column size library: the fallback of the column finder (geoengine._column_shapes). Edit this file to add sizes; no code change is needed. Restart the app after editing it.

The finder works in three tiers. 1: the floor's column group standing on a grid (unchanged). 2: other drawn closed shapes with column evidence - on a column layer, or this floor's own column size on a crossing of its grid. 3: a drawn closed shape whose size is in this library, hatched, standing alone (no wall runs into it) and on a crossing of the floor's grid (any place when the floor has no grid). A hatched library size touching walls or off the grid is only marked on AI_REVIEW; an unhatched one is left alone. A block's box alone (INSERT) is never taken by tiers 2 and 3.
Sizes in mm, matched either way round. A rectangle is [a, b]; a round column (rcc_round, steel CHS) is its diameter.

match_order: where a size is looked up; the first match names the column. project: the lists under projects whose match words are in the drawing's file name or project name (a project with no match words always applies). floor_confirmed: the sizes of the columns tier 1 found on this floor. RCC is looked up before steel, so a 400 mm square reads RCC 400x400, not SHS 400; a steel size not on the RCC list still reads as steel.
tolerance: [mm, share] - a size matches within the larger of the two (share x the size).
limits: the shapes tiers 2 and 3 look at at all (shorter side, longer side, longer / shorter). Tier 1 keeps its own limits.

not_column_layer_words: a shape drawn on a layer with one of these words in its name (or on a wall layer) is never a column by the library or by the floor's own size. A shape on a column layer (COLUMN, _COL, COL-, PILLAR ...) is taken whatever its size.
steel: IS 808 ISHB / ISWB / ISMB as [depth, flange width]; SHS (IS 4923) side; CHS outside diameter. imported: HE-A / HE-B (EN 10365) and UC (BS 4) as depth d x flange width b.
